report: Pruritic painful periorbital scaly crusted plaques, lupus nephritis history, and prior hydroxychloroquine cessation for retinal toxicity suggest cutaneous lupus erythematosus. Biopsy shows vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy, characteristic of lupus. Expert pathologist and laboratory physician concordantly favor cutaneous lupus erythematosus, specifically a hydroxychloroquine withdrawal-associated flare. DIF and serologies are pending.
